primary_ownership_rule: For every compression item in Parts A-C, its frozen SOURCE_UNITS array is the exact set of effective parse units for which that item is the one and only primary compression owner.
candidate_header_defect_note: Part B and Part C declared item_count metadata is incorrect (34 vs 36; 26 vs 27), but ownership is determined from enumerated item objects and their exact SOURCE_UNITS arrays. No source-unit owner depends on the defective header fields.
reconstruction_procedure: Read the effective parse IDs from the three R26 parse payloads.
Read every enumerated compression item from Parts A-C.
For each item, emit one projection pair for every ID in its SOURCE_UNITS array.
Sort by parse-unit ID; the result is 359 primary projection entries spanning exactly R26P0001-R26P0273 and R26U0001-R26U0086 once each.
